summary_en: ¥10.0B limit, 40.0M shares (2.5% S/O), common stock, ceiling price not disclosed, execution Aug 4 2026–Mar 31 2027, method not specified in excerpt.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Marubeni Corporation's board of directors resolved on 3 August 2026 to acquire treasury stock under the authorization granted in the articles of incorporation pursuant to the Companies Act (Article 165, paragraph 2). The company will acquire up to 40.0 million shares (approximately 2.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥10.0 billion as part of enhanced shareholder returns following a capital allocation review announced in the Q1 FY2027 earnings release. The acquisition period runs from 4 August 2026 through 31 March 2027. The company states that progress in the medium-term strategy "GC2027" and increased confidence in free cash flow generation support both enhanced shareholder returns and improved capital efficiency. The specific acquisition method and price ceiling are not disclosed in this excerpt.
